# Product page: Trail Runner 2

A product page for our new trail running shoe, Trail Runner 2, on the Stride online store. Build it as a React app, using mock data. For the look, you can take inspiration from this design:

![Trail Runner 2 product page](design.jpg)

- **Store:** the shopper sees the store name and how many items are in their cart.
- **Menu:** the shopper can go to the store's main sections, such as men, women and kids, from the top of the page.
- **Path:** the shopper sees where the shoe sits in the store, such as Shop, Trail, Trail Runner 2, and can go back to any earlier step.
- **Photos:** the shopper sees one photo of the shoe at a time and moves to the next or previous one, going back to the first after the last.
- **Price:** the shopper sees the price and can point at a small "i" next to it to learn that it includes taxes.
- **Color:** the shopper can choose blue, black or grey; only the chosen color shows until they change it, each with a round swatch.
- **Size:** the shopper picks one size from a list that only opens when they want to change it; only the chosen size shows, and sold-out sizes can't be picked.
- **Size guide:** the shopper can open a size chart over the page from next to the size, enter their foot length and choose US or EU to get their size, and must close it to continue.
- **Quantity:** the shopper can choose how many pairs to buy, typing the number or changing it by one.
- **Add to cart:** the shopper adds the shoe to the cart and sees a confirmation; without a size they are asked to pick one.
- **Wishlist:** the shopper can save or unsave the shoe with a heart.
- **More information:** details, reviews and shipping sit side by side below everything, with one section shown at a time.
- **Questions:** a few common questions about the shoe, each with its answer hidden until the shopper opens it.
- **Bottom of the page:** the shopper finds customer help, company and social media links.

page.on('console', (msg) => msg.type() === 'error' && consoleErrors.push(msg.text()))

await page.goto('http://localhost:4173/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })

// 1. Page renders
check('page title', (await page.title()) === 'Trail Runner 2 | Stride')
check('h1 renders', (await page.locator('h1').textContent()) === 'Trail Runner 2')
check('store name renders', await page.locator('.store-name').isVisible())
check('cart link label', (await page.locator('.cart-link').getAttribute('aria-label')) === 'Cart, 0 items')
check('gallery svg renders', await page.locator('.shoe-svg').isVisible())
check('no console errors on load', consoleErrors.length === 0, consoleErrors.join('; '))
await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/page-top.png' })

// 2. Gallery wrap-around via keyboard
const nextBtn = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next photo' })
await nextBtn.focus()
await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
await page.keyboard.press('Enter') // 3 nexts from photo 1 -> back to photo 1
check('carousel wraps to first', (await page.locator('.gallery-status').textContent()).includes('Photo 1 of 3'))
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Previous photo' }).press('Enter')
check('previous wraps to last', (await page.locator('.gallery-status').textContent()).includes('Photo 3 of 3'))

  (els) => els.filter((e) => e.tabIndex === 0).length === 1))
await checkedRadio.focus()
await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight')
check('arrow changes color', (await page.locator('#color-label').textContent()).includes('Black'))
check('focus follows selection', await page.evaluate(
  () => document.activeElement.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Black'))

await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown')
check('listbox opens', await page.getByRole('listbox').isVisible())
check('focus moves into list', await page.evaluate(

check('size selected', (await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Size, US 7/ }).count()) === 1)
check('listbox closed after select', (await page.getByRole('listbox').count()) === 0)

await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown') // US 8
await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown') // US 9 sold out
await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
check('sold-out not selectable', await page.getByRole('listbox').isVisible())
await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
check('escape closes listbox', (await page.getByRole('listbox').count()) === 0)

await page.evaluate(() => { /* reset: select no size not possible; test error path via fresh reload later */ })

await guideBtn.focus()
await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
check('dialog opens', await page.getByRole('dialog').isVisible())
check('dialog aria-modal', (await page.getByRole('dialog').getAttribute('aria-modal')) === 'true')
check('focus inside dialog', await page.evaluate(

check('shift+tab wraps within dialog', await page.evaluate(

await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
check('tooltip hides on escape', (await page.getByRole('tooltip').count()) === 0)

check('aria-expanded true', (await q.getAttribute('aria-expanded')) === 'true')

await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to cart' }).click()
check('size error alert', await page.getByRole('alert').isVisible())
check('focus moved to size button', await page.evaluate(
  () => document.activeElement.getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'listbox'))
// pick size 8 via keyboard
await page.keyboard.press('Enter') // open listbox
await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown')
await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown') // US 8
await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
// quantity stepper
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Increase quantity' }).click()
check('quantity is 2', (await page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Quantity' }).inputValue()) === '2')
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to cart' }).click()
check('confirmation announced', (await page.locator('.confirmation').textContent()).includes('2 × Trail Runner 2'))
check('cart count updated', (await page.locator('.cart-link').getAttribute('aria-label')) === 'Cart, 2 items')

// 11. Wishlist toggle
const wish = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save to wishlist' })
await wish.click()
check('wishlist pressed', (await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove from wishlist' }).getAttribute('aria-pressed')) === 'true')

// 12. Footer sections
check('footer help links', await page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Customer help' }).isVisible())
check('footer social links', await page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Follow us' }).isVisible())

// 13. axe-core WCAG 2.2 AA scan
const axeSource = readFileSync('/work/node_modules/axe-core/axe.min.js', 'utf8')
await page.evaluate(axeSource)
const axe = await page.evaluate(async () => {
  return await window.axe.run(document, { runOnly: { type: 'tag', values: ['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag22aa'] } })
})
const violations = axe.violations.map((v) => `${v.id}: ${v.nodes.length} node(s)`)
check('axe wcag2a/2aa/22aa scan', axe.violations.length === 0, violations.join('; ') || 'no violations')

await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/page-full.png', fullPage: true })
await browser.close()

const failed = results.filter((r) => !r.ok)
console.log(`\n${results.length - failed.length}/${results.length} checks passed`)
process.exit(failed.length ? 1 : 0)
